name: public-local-calculation
description: Compute a small local numerical summary and retain its artifact.

calculate.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json,math,os,statistics
from pathlib import Path
p=json.loads(os.environ.get('MATOS_WORKFLOW_PARAMETERS_JSON','{}'))
x=p.get('values',[1,2,3])
assert isinstance(x,list) and x and all(type(v) in (int,float) and math.isfinite(v) for v in x), 'values must be finite numbers'
r={'count':len(x),'mean':statistics.mean(x),'population_std':statistics.pstdev(x)}
out=Path(os.environ['MATOS_WORKFLOW_ARTIFACT_ROOT'])/'summary.json'
out.write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(r))
PY
